market_summary: Late New York session trading across major symbols sees price action consolidating into tight ranges. FX majors (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and Gold are holding near session lows below VWAP inside value areas or stretched on low volume, while US100 and BTCUSD remain elevated above VWAP but are hitting overhead structural resistance (Call Wall #1 / Session Highs). Strict confluence is lacking across all instruments, favoring HOLD positions.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4023.16) and below POC (4044.14). CVD is BEARISH (-3.00) with negative slope (-0.08), supporting downside. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is strongly below VWAP and EMA50 baseline. Price is testing the lower ATR band (3989.0) near Session Low (3982.90). RVOL is low (0.841) with no active yellow volume spikes, indicating late-session extension risk near support.
signals.level_event: rejection at lower ATR band testing Session Low

Holding near Session Low (1.32661) without a fresh breakout signal.

Buying directly into Call Wall #1 without clean acceptance is low R:R.
